    About this item

    • HOODED DESIGN - Classic fleece hoodie styling featuring a dyed-to-match drawstring for the perfect fit.
    • UNISEX SIZING - This hooded sweatshirt is designed with a standard men’s fit that also creates an effortless, oversized look for women. Model is 5'8" and wearing a size medium.
    • COMFY COZY - Midweight fleece keeps you warm without the bulk.
    • KANGAROO POCKET - This men's sweatshirt features a front kangaroo pocket to keep hands warm and hold small, everyday essentials.
    • MADE TO LAST - Comfortable design with double-needle stitching at the neck and armholes for added sturdiness. Sporty ribbed cuffs and hem hold their shape.

    Product Description

    Add comfort and warmth to your casual wardrobe with a Hanes EcoSmart® men's hoodie. Super soft and cozy, this hooded pullover is made with cotton sourced from American farms for a feel-good finish. Crafted with the Hanes quality you expect, it's made to hold its shape thanks to double-needle stitching at the neck and armholes. You'll appreciate classic hoodie details like ribbed cuffs and hem and a front kangaroo pocket. The perfect layering piece, this warm men's fleece sweatshirt is sure to become your new go-to sweatshirt.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    • Kaleb Kilcoyne
      5.0 out of 5 stars Buy again
      Reviewed in the United States on January 20, 2026
      Size: LargeColor: BlackVerified Purchase
      I’ve been wearing the Hanes EcoSmart Hoodie (Midweight Fleece) regularly for a few weeks, and it’s become one of my go-to everyday hoodies.

      The midweight fleece feels soft and comfortable right away. It’s warm enough for cool mornings and brisk evenings without feeling bulky or stiff. The classic fit is true to size and not too oversized, so it works well on its own or layered under a jacket.

      I also appreciate the build quality. The stitching feels solid, and after several washes the hoodie still looks good — no pilling or fading so far. The kangaroo pocket is roomy enough for my phone, keys, or small essentials, and the hood sits right without collapsing or flopping forward.

      Fit and sizing were accurate for me. The cuffs and waistband hold their shape, and the fabric has just enough stretch to stay comfortable all day.

      A few small points:
      • It’s not the thickest hoodie I’ve ever owned — if you need heavy winter warmth, you might want a heavier option.
      • The design is basic, but that also makes it versatile and easy to wear with anything.

      Overall this hoodie feels comfortable, reliable, and great for daily wear. It’s exactly what I’d expect from a classic fleece hoodie and worth the price.
